backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles and service requests with permission checks, CRUD operations, and admin-only request oversight.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs for admin dashboard enhancements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of all major frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base configuration defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes and applying global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point containing the root mount node and script loader for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router configuration and top-level app routes including the admin dashboard.
frontend/src/components/CategoryGrid.tsx: Renders clickable category cards that navigate to the service request form with pre-selected categories.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button managing Internet Identity authentication with loading handling and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/PageLayout.tsx: Global layout wrapper providing header, footer, and content outlet for all routed pages.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: A wrapper component that checks for an authenticated Internet Identity and shows a login card when the user is not signed in.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Renders the site header with navigation links, admin visibility logic, login button, and a responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login handling, and identity persistence through a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for CRUD operations on requests, user profiles, and admin actions using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables defining light and dark theme color tokens and global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Root entry that sets up the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard page providing request filtering, sorting, metrics, editing, and CSV export, protected by admin checks.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page showing hero content, appliance categories, and feature highlights with a call-to-action to register a service request.
frontend/src/pages/MyRequestsPage.tsx: Displays the logged-in user's service requests with loading, error, empty, and table views plus navigation to request creation.
frontend/src/pages/RegisterRequestPage.t: Form page for creating a new service or spares request with validation, category selection, and submission logic.
frontend/src/pages/RequestDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific request with loading/error handling and navigation back to the user's requests.
frontend/src/pages/RequestSuccessPage.ts: Confirmation page displaying the submitted request ID and navigation options after a successful request submission.
Computes total, open, closed, and unassigned request counts from a list of requests.
frontend/src/utils/adminRequestsView.ts: Provides search, filter, and sorting utilities for generating a visible list of admin request entries.
frontend/src/utils/csvExport.ts: Builds and downloads a CSV file from a list of Request objects, escaping fields and formatting timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides helpers to format bigint nanosecond timestamps into readable or short date strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based query values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file describing the app’s purpose, features, versions, and metadata.
